test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

All engineers are intelligent.

Some doctors are engineers.

Conclusion:

I. Some doctors are intelligent.

II. All intelligent people are engineers.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdcdeabf6539531f7e4f1570b3c160eb77871a8b188d3e52c64a5787b05a849d.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some doctors are intelligent →** Follow** (As given all engineers are intelligent and some doctors are engineers. so, some doctors are definitely intelligent).

II. All intelligent people are engineers → **Does not follow** (All Engineers are intelligent but vice versa is not follow).
